summary.text: Mitchell Cornett is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 46th District, which covers Grayson County, part of Pulaski County, Smyth County and Wythe County, and has served since January 14, 2026.
Cornett sits on the House committees on Public Safety and Health and Human Services.

paragraphs.text: Mitchell Cornett was born in Marion, VA, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Cornett's education as AAS in Emergency Medical Services, Southwest Virginia Community College.
The profile gives Cornett's occupation as real-estate broker, cattle farmer.
Cornett's listed memberships and affiliations include Paramedic-Independence Volunteer Rescue Squad.
